While these characteristics contribute to its timeless beauty, the high calcium content and fine grain also define its specific polishing requirements and susceptibility to certain types of damage.

faqs.q: Can Crema Marfil regain its shine after prolonged neglect, or is some damage irreversible?

faqs.q: How can I distinguish between light scratches and deep etches on my Crema Marfil marble?
faqs.a: Light scratches appear as faint, surface‑level lines that disappear under a fingertip pressure or when the stone is wet. Deep etches are more pronounced, feel rough to the touch, and often retain a visible groove even when wet. A simple water‑drop test—if the drop spreads evenly, the mark is likely a scratch; if it beads, it’s an etch.
